title: Deferred reprojection corpus
description: Language-agnostic cases of deferred history steps (design §16.6, N17) over the store's demo mutation family. A store authors `history` (runs of edits by its local actor or another actor) and defers its local and remote Report replays by `budget` operations per turn (`null`: replays inside the dispatch). Each step dispatches a history command or ingests a remote supersession, which folds its first turn inside that call. Optionally it then makes `after` further turns before an interrupt (discard the waiting local step, cancel the running replay, or apply an edit that lands on the history before the step). It then steps turns until the step is adopted or refused. A turn folds operations until it has folded `budget` of them, and asks after every operation. Closing an edit folds nothing. So a replay of R operations waits iff R >= budget, the dispatch is followed by floor(R / budget) turns, and a restarted replay takes floor(R' / budget) + 1 turns. Every case changes the history at position 0 or at the live head, so no retained prefix shortens a replay and R is exact.

run.description: `times` consecutive edits of `edit`, authored by the store's local actor or by another actor (whose edits the local undo skips).

target.description: The operation `op` of the `edit`-th authored edit.

oneOf.description: Undo the local actor's latest applied edit.
Switch back to the trunk alternative.
A local finalize (`supersede`) or the ingest of another replica's supersession (`remoteSupersede`) of `target`.
A finalize as a new alternative `name` branched at the head, which it switches to.

replayed.description: R: the operations the step's Report replay folds (0 when it needs none). This is the replay's progress total while it waits.

waits.description: Whether the step still waits after its dispatch. While it waits the store shows and records the history from before the step.

turns.description: The turns after the dispatch (after the interrupt, when there is one) until the step is adopted or refused. 0 after a discard.

refused.description: `rejected`: the finalize's replay blocks (an error or fatal outcome). It is refused with `Rejected { policy: Normal }` and nothing of it is recorded.

interruptedState.description: What the store shows right after an interrupting edit: that edit folded onto the history from before the step.

applied.description: Applied edits at the head afterwards.

supersessions.description: Effective supersessions at the head afterwards.
